title: UNTOLD STORIES
author: Sansao Lino

title: Make it Big
author: MakeItBigAgency
description:
Every brand wants to grow. But growing well without burning out, losing what makes you special, or losing sight of what matters is another story.

Make It Big is the show about building growth that lasts. Hosts Anel Imanbay and Mafalda Brito explore how brands and personal brands scale, what makes people trust a name for the long run, and how to grow sustainably.

Each episode brings you honest conversations, useful strategies, and lessons from brands that grew on purpose. You’ll hear what worked, what didn’t, and how to put practical ideas to work this week. Along the way, we’ll unpack a few myths about going viral.

Whether you’re a founder, marketer, creator, or building a name of your own, Make It Big helps you see what sustainable growth can look like.

Make it Big. Build your intelligent growth that will last.

title: Imagine On Air by Wordfest
author: Wordfest
description: Wordfest™ beams out from the foothills of the Canadian Rockies, Treaty 7 territory. We are an entrepreneurial arts non-profit founded in 1996 as one of Canada’s leading literary festivals. Our small team’s mission (which is to connect the world’s best audiences with the world’s best authors) has evolved to include producing 100+ lively, accessible experiences every year – virtually and in theatres in Calgary. We operate on Mountain Air, which we define as a breath of fresh air, and it’s our absolute joy to create fine-tuned, idea-based experiences for you.

title: Avatars
author: Rabindra Ratan
description: Avatars is a podcast about the digital representations of ourselves—and others—that increasingly shape how we live, work, play, and connect. Hosted by Rabindra Ratan, author of Avatars: What They Are and Why They Matter (2027) the show explores the psychology, technology, and social implications of avatars, from video games and virtual reality to AI agents and digital humans, to explore what avatars reveal about who we are—and who we might become.

title: co-creating belonging
author: David Hasbury
description:
“We are biologically, cognitively, physically, and spiritually wired to love, to be loved, and to belong.” Brené Brown


In a world that has been designed to separate and divide people, there is a need to draw our attention to what is possible when we pay attention to cultivating conditions that make our basic nature as humans to survive and flourish -- to love, be loved, belong, and co-create the world we will leave to generations that follow.


Join me, David Hasbury, in conversation with people who cultivate the conditions in which life, love, belonging, and co-creation can take root and thrive.

Working to re-create this world, for our common good.

title: Pneuma Counseling
author: Rick Manabat
description:
Pneuma Counseling is about healing from sex addiction, trauma, and betrayal, for the person struggling, for the partner who's been hurt, and for the couple trying to find their way back to each other. Rick Manabat, a Certified Sex Addiction Therapist (CSAT), EMDR-trained clinician, and founder of Pneuma Counseling, talks honestly about sex and porn addiction, the trauma and shame that often drive it, betrayal trauma, and what real recovery looks like. Rick's approach looks past the behavior to the story underneath it, with compassion for the addict, care for the betrayed partner, and a path toward rebuilding trust and intimacy as a couple.

Pneuma Counseling specializes in sex addiction therapy, trauma recovery and EMDR, betrayal trauma therapy for partners, and couples counseling after betrayal, with offices in Chicago, IL and Colorado Springs, CO, plus telehealth. Learn more or schedule an appointment at https://www.pneumachicago.com

title: The Clearsound Marketing Podcast
author: Clearsound Consulting
description: Welcome to the Clearsound Marketing Podcast, where we help you stand out from the noise and create a clear sound by teaching you how to connect with your audience and grow your business through branding and marketing strategies. Clearsound serves businesses across the US from Grove City, PA, and across the UK from London.

title: WEPC Makers Podcast
author: West End Presbyterian Church RVA
description:
Join us for a brand-new podcast where we hear from West End Presbyterian Church RVA artists & creatives about their creative process, the stories behind their work, and what making teaches us about ourselves and the God who made us. Hosted by Gordon Collier & Becca Wethered, produced by Owen Wilcox.

title: The First Sip
author: Bethany Zachman
description:
What if there isn't one right way to build a business, be a mom, or be a woman?

Welcome to The First Sip, a podcast about motherhood, business, identity, ambition, and the choices we get to make along the way.


Twice a month, join Bethany Zachman for honest, coffee-date-style conversations about the messy, beautiful parts of building a life that feels like your own. From making your own money and chasing big dreams to changing your mind, wanting less, and figuring out what enough really means.


No perfect answers. No five-step formulas. Just real conversations, a little space to reconnect with yourself, and a reminder that you get to choose your own way.


So grab your coffee. Let's take the first sip together.

title: First In IP Law
author: The Legal Podcast Network (LPN)
description: First in IP Law is a podcast dedicated to exploring the intricacies of intellectual property law and its impact on innovation. Hosted by experts in the field, the show offers insights into the legal strategies that protect and enhance the value of intellectual property for inventors, entrepreneurs, and businesses. With a focus on clarity and practical advice, First in IP Law serves as a valuable resource for anyone looking to navigate the complex world of IP law. Whether you're an inventor, a legal professional, or simply curious about the field, this podcast provides a comprehensive understanding of how intellectual property shapes the competitive landscape.

description:
Alternative history isn't just a genre — it's a conversation. I take you places you've never been: the Richat Structure, the Eye of the Sahara, Atlantis, Homer's world. I've stood in the Richat Structure three times, and I believe it was the capital of Atlantis. This is where we talk about it.

title: The kids behavior  Podcast
author: kidsbehavior
description:
Hello, everyone, and welcome to our podcast!

Are you a parent who wants to understand your child better? Do you sometimes wonder why children cry, get angry, refuse to listen, or behave in unexpected ways?

You are in the right place!

Here, we explore children’s behavior, emotions, discipline, communication, and positive parenting. Together, we’ll learn how to guide our children with love, patience, and understanding.

Remember, every child is unique, and every behavior is an opportunity to learn.

So, let’s grow together and build happier, healthier families.

Welcome to our channel! Let’s get started!”

title: Women Aging Powerfully
author: Leah Vachani
description: Curious about unlocking the secrets to thriving through menopause? Join Leah Vachani, Certified Menopause Specialist & Nutrition Coach as each episode features dynamic discussions with top thought leaders in women's health, diving into crucial topics often overlooked by many health providers—nutrition, fitness, hormones, stress management, sleep and more. We simplify complex science into practical steps for your daily life, empowering you to tackle menopausal symptoms, conquer weight challenges, and boost your overall health. This isn't just about aging gracefully; it’s about aging powerfully!

title: Astonishing Legends
author: BN
description:
The world is more mysterious than most people are comfortable imagining. We cross paths with the mystical from time to time and may not even notice it. If we do, we quickly return to our usually mundane daily existence. But what if we not only acknowledged the unknown, we investigated it and spoke with those in the know? That's what co-hosts Scott Philbrook & Forrest Burgess, and co-executive producer Tess Pfeifle do at Astonishing Legends. Over 100 million downloads and hundreds of thousands of listeners have discovered the thrill of exploring the mysteries of our world, showing that the unknown can be both captivating and intriguing. Welcome to Astonishing Legends!

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Power at Home
author: The Analyst + ColoredJuice Podcast Studio
description: Power at Home is the home-energy show that does the maths honestly. Every episode takes one energy question - solar panels, home batteries, generators, insulation, and the electric bill itself - and works the real numbers out loud: what it costs, what it saves, how long payback actually takes, and who should skip it. No hype and no sales pitch, just the spec sheet read carefully, with every figure sourced and every assumption stated. Hosted by The Analyst. New episodes two to three times a week. Power at Home is a ColoredJuice Podcast Studio show.

title: LST
author: Kathryn Walker and Blake Reagan
description:
LST – Love, Safety, Trust
Hosted by Kathryn A. Walker, CRNA, PMHNP & Blake Reagan, JD
What if understanding mental health started with three fundamental human needs: love, safety, and trust?
Welcome to "LST", a podcast challenging the way we think about mental health, human behavior, relationships, and the experiences that shape our lives.
Join co-hosts, Kathryn A. Walker, psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner, nurse anesthetist, researcher, and author of - Inflamed: Love, Safety, Trust, and Blake Reagan, JD, attorney and medical ethics consultant

title: Rebuild with Christ
author: Deborah Phenyo-Victor
description:
Stop leaning. Start aligning. ⚖️✨
​In a world filled with "good vibes" and "follow your heart" advice, where do you go when your life feels out of sync? 
How do you fix a foundation that is cracking under the weight of marital struggles, career burnout, or spiritual exhaustion?
​Welcome to Rebuild, Reconcile, Restore, hosted by Biblical Life Coach Deborah Phenyo (Victor). Drawing from the wisdom of her namesake—the judge and prophet—and the power of her surname Phenyo (Victory), Deborah helps you navigate life’s "dry seasons" by returning to the only Blueprint that works: The Word of God.
​

title: Rebuild with Rachael
author: Rachael Twist
description:
Rebuild with Rachael is a personal growth podcast about going from rock bottom to manifestation, and what it actually takes to change your life.
I'm Rachael, and each week I tell one story from my own life about the moments that changed my life. If you're curious about manifestation, mindset, and changint eh story you've been told about your life, start here.

title: The Rebuild with Jake
author: Jacob Bell
description:
Life doesn't always go to plan. Sometimes it throws you a curveball and leaves you wondering, “Well... what now?”
I'm Jake, and welcome to The Rebuild with Jake.
After some pretty big changes in my life, I decided it was time to stop waiting for “one day” and start creating a life I'm genuinely excited about.
I haven't got all the answers (not even close), but I'm learning, making mistakes, celebrating the little wins and figuring things out as I go.
If you're rebuilding too, pull up a chair. You're not alone in this.

title: Worth Knowing from WTQ
author: R. Scott Armstrong
description:
Conversations from both sides of the brief.

Scott Armstrong sits down with marketing leaders and agency leaders, independent and in-house, to talk about what they’ve learned working with each other. How good client relationships get built, how the work gets done, and what changes when you move from one side of the brief to the other.

title: Cognitive Shuffle Sleep: Mental Reset & Deep Sleep Audio
author: Sleep Laboratory
description:
Thank you for your hard work today.
This is the main session (Night 1) of the "Cognitive Shuffle Sleep Method," using random words and 10-second pauses to quiet your mind and guide you into natural sleep.
💡 Tips for Listening
- Don't repeat the words or connect them; just visualize them passing by like flashcards.
- Adjust the app's playback speed if the 10-second pauses feel too long or you prefer another pace.
Get comfortable and gently prepare for sleep. Before you know it, you'll be drifting into deep, restful sleep...
Good night.

title: The Land of Hidden Men (Jungle Adventures of Courage)
author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
description:
When Gordon King ventures into the heart of an uncharted jungle, he uncovers a world steeped in ancient secrets and hidden dangers. This gripping journey plunges him into the Land of Hidden Men—a realm where superstition meets reality and every shadow could hide a threat. As he navigates this treacherous landscape, Gordon encounters a society shrouded in mystery, where the line between friend and foe blurs.

Driven by his thirst for adventure, he quickly realizes that bravery alone may not guarantee survival. What begins as a quest for discovery transforms into a fight against unseen forces that threaten to keep him captive forever. With each twist and turn, listeners will unravel the layers of intrigue surrounding the jungle's inhabitants and their customs.

As Gordon faces formidable challenges, he must rely on his wits and courage, forcing you to ponder: how far would you go to unlock the secrets of the unknown? The Land of Hidden Men invites you on an exhilarating exploration of courage, survival, and the complexities of human nature. Join Gordon in this thrilling tale where every decision could mean the difference between life and death, and the greatest mysteries are often found in the depths of our fears.

Welcome to DNN – Daily News Network, your destination for the latest news, breaking developments and important stories shaping the world. 

We bring you clear, engaging and informative coverage of US news, international affairs, politics, business, technology, security and major global events.

Our mission is to keep you informed through concise news reports, relevant insights and straightforward explanations of the stories that matter.

From Washington to the rest of the world, DNN follows the developments making headlines and helps you understand why they matter
.
Stay informed. Stay connected. Stay ahead.

Follow DNN – Daily News Network

#DNN – The World. Every Day.

Hosted by Hugo Will, each episode features intimate conversations with top DPs, directors, and visual artists - from Hollywood veterans to rising indie talents. Together, we break down iconic scenes, explore creative processes, tackle technical challenges, and talk honestly about the craft and career of visual storytelling. Whether you’re on set, in prep, or just starting out, CineTalk is your backstage pass to the minds shaping modern cinema - raw, real, and full of insight.

title: Upper Claws: The Prehistoric Files

Welcome to Upper Claws: The Prehistoric Files hosted by Cohen!
Join young dinosaur enthusiast Cohen as he travels millions of years into the past to uncover the amazing world of dinosaurs and prehistoric creatures. Each episode explores a different dinosaur, including what it ate, where it lived, how it survived, and incredible facts you might not know.
Get your claws ready! It's time to dig into the prehistoric files!

title: Lean and Strong in Perimenopause Podcast
author: Courtney Whitten
description:
Lean & Strong in Perimenopause is for women 40+ who want to build muscle, lose fat, and finally see real physique change. We talk muscle building, fat loss, metabolism, food noise, and how to build a lean & strong body in perimenopause — without quick fixes and gimmicks that just leave you frustrated. 
Hosted by Courtney Whitten, certified personal trainer & coach for women 40+, this show is your no-fluff guide for lifting smart, eating for your hormones-so you can finally see real, sustainable results. Let's make this phase of life your strongest one yet!

title: "Explicit Thoughts" Podcast
author: Bobbi & Devince
description: It’s been a long time coming, years actually, but we’re finally in a place to share our story. The “Explicit Thoughts” Podcast is on its way. For all of the millennials out there trying to navigate life, WE ARE YOU!! Ya’ll tap in with us as we share our 15 year journey of loving one another, marriage, careers, kids, and a multitude of ups and downs. Give us a follow!! You won’t regret it.

title: The DM Show- Random But Relevant.
author: D M Livingston
description:
Welcome to The DM Show, where no subject is off limits simply because it doesn't fit neatly into a category. Hosted by DM Livingston , publisher and editor of The Waterbury Times, this is an eclectic mix of news, commentary, conversations, personal observations, unconventional ideas, and questions worth asking.


Sometimes we'll break down what's happening in Waterbury. Other times, we'll take a look at Hartford, Washington, or the world beyond our borders. We might discuss politics, explore an interesting idea, revisit a piece of history, talk sports, or disappear down an unexpected rabbit hole.


The common thread? There's always something worth talking about.


No manufactured controversy. No predetermined talking points. Just curiosity, perspective, honest conversation, and a willingness to explore subjects from different angles.


Random But Relevant. Because everything connects to something.


This is The DM Show.

title: Tea with the Master
author: Pete Bampton
description:
Tea with the Master is an oral history podcast exploring the lived experience of people who have spent time in the orbit of Spiritual Masters and their related communal experiments in both independent and traditional contexts since the 1970s.

The emphasis is to illuminate the profundity and radically transformative potential of the relationship with an authentic Master (of whatever degree of purity and depth) in both human and Spiritual form. 

Explorations into the nature of awakening, transmission, devotion, discipline, doubt, potentials and pitfalls...

...Life inside spiritual communities since the 70s

...What happens when people reorganise their lives around a teacher

…Bringing lived perspective to sensationalised controversies

…Lessons learned from life in spirituality charged contexts that break beyond social and ethical norms

If you are interested being interviewed about your own relationship with a Master, please contact me at: pete.bampton@gmail.com

Verse-by-verse studies of the King James Bible. Each episode explains older KJV words in plain English, reads the passage in context, and gives you something to look for on your next read.
Produced by Montrale K Davis
Published by Heir Lifestyle Investments LLC
Find study notes at kjvbiblebrokendown.blogspot.com. KJV merchandise: https://kjv-bible-broken-down.myspreadshop.com/

title: Martin & Neil Aren't Qualified
author: Goat Films
description:
Just when the world needs no more podcasts, two men bravely step forward to give the public exactly what they didn't ask for.  

In a landscape crowded with overqualified historians, pundits, finance experts and wellness gurus, a new comedy podcast -  Martin & Neil Aren't Qualified - stands proudly apart.

Each episode will see Martin Clunes and Neil Morrissey tackle three listener dilemmas and offer their uniquely unqualified advice - they will use this agony uncle format as a springboard for anecdotes, tangents and stories from their thirty-plus years of shared history .  

When it comes to their advice…  Nobody asked for it, and probably, nobody should take it.

title: The Kings Table
author: Aa'Reck Wiggins
description: Pull up a chair. The Kings Table is a real conversation between men who are trying to live out their faith in everyday life, not just talk about it on Sunday.  Each episode, we open the Word and ask the questions that matter: What does this actually look like at work, at home, in our marriages, with our kids, and when life gets hard? No church performance and no religious talk that sounds good but doesn’t help. Just honest discussion and Scripture you can take with you and use.  We’re not here because we’ve got it all figured out. We’re here because we decided to seek God together and keep each other accountable along the way. If you’re looking for faith that holds up in real life, you’ve got a seat at this table.  New episodes regularly. Listen in, share it with a brother who needs it, and come back hungry.

title: Superwoman to Sovereign Woman: Self-Leadership for Women
author: Christina Charters
description:
Are you a Superwoman who’s tired of centring everyone and everything but yourself?

Superwoman to Sovereign Woman is a podcast about self-awareness, self-leadership and personal growth for women. I talk to women who realised that putting others (or work, or the to-do list) first isn’t how to live a life, and hear when that realisation hit and how they moved into the Sovereign Woman archetype: centring themselves in their own lives.

Expect honest conversations and practical advice on people-pleasing, burnout, self-trust, boundaries and building a life that’s actually yours.

Think coffee and deep chats at your best friend’s house. Come pull up a chair.

title: Let's Talk Seminary
author: It's Been Real
description:
Choosing the right seminary is a big decision.
And big decisions deserve real conversations.
Let’s Talk Seminary brings you honest conversations with the people behind each English-speaking Chabad seminary, about their vision, goals, and setup, so you can get to know your options and find the right fit for you.

title: Beyond the Wounds
author: Israel
description:
healing the past, embracing God’s wisdom, and living in differently.
Beyond the rules is a podcast dedicated to helping people break free from the pain of their past unhealthy patterns, and experiencing genuine healing through God’s wisdom. 
Our past experiences, childhood, traumas, disappointments, and unresolved wounds can quietly influence how we think ,respond, love, communicate, and beautiful relationships but, he requires more than simply acknowledging what hurt us, it requires understanding, accountability transformation, and the willingness to apply God’s principles to our lives.

author: TBBwithcarley
description: The Broken Butterfly with Carley Frank is a podcast about the experiences that shape us, the challenges we face, and the conversations we don't always know how to have. Through personal stories and honest conversations, we'll explore grief, loss, mental health, relationships, growing up, life changes, and everything in between. title: The Cage Door
author: Knockabout Media
description:
The Cage Door: The Life and Works of Margaret Laurence traces the writer’s remarkable life, from her childhood in Neepawa, Manitoba, through her formative years in Africa and her emergence as one of Canada’s most influential novelist. Through archival recordings, expert interviews, and immersive sound design, this new series also examines the more complicated chapters of Laurence’s legacy, including recurrent debates and controversies surrounding her work and efforts to remove her books from classrooms and libraries. Discover the life, legacy, and ongoing relevance of one of Canada’s most influential writers.


A Knockabout Media Production

This podcast was made possible thanks to funding from the Government of Canada.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: IWM Vienna: Politics, Philosophy & Current Affairs
author: IWMVienna

Bookéké was born out of our desire to take those conversations beyond our DMs and share them with the world. We believe books are more than stories; they are windows into different lives, cultures, histories and ways of seeing the world. And what better way to explore Africa than through the stories told by its people?
Our reading journey will take us across the continent, exploring works from as many African countries as we can. From Nigeria to Tunisia, Ghana to Botswana, and everywhere in between.
And this isn’t about rating books or deciding whether they’re worth reading. It’s about engaging with ideas, questioning perspectives, sharing opinions, discovering unfamiliar worlds and, sometimes, disagreeing along the way.
Think of it as travelling around Africa, one book and one conversation at a time.

title: Girl, What Was I Thinking?
author: Zada Monroe
description:
Girl, What Was I Thinking?

With Zada Monroe | A Girl2Woman Podcast

We're grown women. But are we really living like we know who we are?

Girl, let's talk about it.

Girl, What Was I Thinking? is a podcast for women over 30 who are tired of questioning their worth, settling for less, overgiving, and losing themselves in relationships, friendships, and everybody else's expectations.

Because here's the thing: Just because we grew up doesn't mean we were taught how to become women who truly know, love, and respect themselves.

Hosted by Zada Monroe, this is a space for honest conversations about the childhood conditioning, unspoken expectations, and survival habits that shaped the women we've become. We're unpacking the good-girl programming, people-pleasing, unhealthy relationship patterns, and limiting beliefs that have followed us well into adulthood.

We'll reflect on the lessons life has taught us (sometimes the hard way), question the behaviors we've normalized, and explore practical ways to build self-worth, establish healthy boundaries, develop emotional maturity, and reconnect with who we are outside of everyone else's needs.

Expect real stories, uncomfortable truths, a little humor, and actionable habits to help you stop operating on autopilot and start becoming a woman you genuinely respect.

This isn't about having it all figured out. It's about finally asking ourselves the questions we should've been asking years ago.

We're recognizing the patterns, reflecting on the lessons, and reinventing the woman.

And girl, we're not gatekeeping what we've learned along the way.

Welcome to Girl, What Was I Thinking?

Recognize. Reflect. Reinvent.

A Girl2Woman Podcast | Girl2Woman.co

title: Profiling Evil
author: Profiling Evil
description:
The Profiling Evil Podcast delves into unsolved criminal cases from around the world, peeling back the layers of human behavior to reveal what drives evil. We look into the mind of the predator—their motivations, their victim selection, and the patterns that expose them. Each episode goes beyond headlines, examining how investigators identify red flags, connect the dots, and capitalize on the very errors offenders believe will never be found.

Your host, Mike King, brings over four decades of experience in criminal justice and behavioral analysis. A retired law enforcement executive, Mike served as Chief of Staff to Utah Attorney General Jan Graham and Weber County Attorney Reed M. Richards. He began his career at the Ogden Police Department, where he worked patrol, motor enforcement, and SWAT before moving into investigations where he led task forces that hunted serial predators and violent offenders.

Mike’s expertise earned him national recognition. He served as co-chair of the FBI’s Violent Criminal Apprehension Program (ViCAP) National Advisory Board, directed UTAP, the Utah Criminal Tracking and Analysis Project, and supported intelligence operations during the 2002 Winter Olympic Games in Salt Lake City.

After retiring from public service, Mike joined the Environmental Systems Research Institute (Esri), where he spent years consulting with police agencies around the globe on intelligence gathering, emergency communications, and major event management. In 2024, he retired again, this time to focus full-time on Profiling Evil and its growing community of true crime investigators, students, and enthusiasts.

Mike is an internationally recognized speaker, trainer, and adjunct professor, as well as a visiting scholar at multiple universities. He’s authored several acclaimed works on crime and human behavior, including:

·      Wolves in Sheep’s Clothing

·      Deceived: An Investigative Memoir of the Zion Society Cult

·      She Knew No Fear

·      Who Killed King Tut?

·      Predators: Who Are They and How Do We Stop Them?

·      Profilers

Mike’s investigative insight and behavioral expertise have been featured on Court TV, NewsNation, Law & Crime Network, Dr. Phil, History’s Greatest Mysteries, and 60 Minutes Australia, where his calm, analytical style helps audiences understand the why behind the world’s most chilling crimes.

At @ProfilingEvil, you’ll find deep dives into real investigations, expert analysis of offender behavior, and lessons in situational awareness and safety. It’s more than storytelling, it’s about learning how to recognize, understand, and ultimately disrupt evil.

Find us @ProfilingEvil on YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

description:
What if you stopped waiting to feel ready and started leading your own life?


I’m Michelle, and InnerCEO is my invitation to step into the CEO role in your own life. Not in the traditional sense of performance, productivity or success measured by the outside world, but by becoming more aware of who you are, what you want, and how you can actively shape your own direction.


So many people move through life on autopilot: following expectations, habits and whichever path seemed safest at the time. I do life differently. Taking ownership of my own choices has given me a kind of freedom I want more people to experience. Because being good at navigating the life you’ve built isn’t enough. You also have to ask yourself whether it’s the life you want to keep building on.


In each episode, I sit down with inspiring people to explore the person behind the success story: the choices that shaped them, the beliefs they had to let go of, the experiments that taught them something, and where they found the courage to take a new path. After every conversation, I follow up with an InnerCEO Reflections solo episode, where I share my own thoughts and leave you with something to reflect on – and perhaps act on.


Everything is guided by the InnerCEO Method: Curiosity, Experiment, Choice and Alignment. It’s not a recipe for the perfect life. It’s an ongoing cycle of exploring, trying, choosing and adjusting. InnerCEO is about self-determination, not self-optimisation. You don’t need to have all the answers. You just need to be willing to ask yourself the questions.


New episodes every Tuesday from February 2027.

Beyond the Steering Wheel: The Future of Self-Driving Cars

Imagine getting into a car, entering your destination, and relaxing while the vehicle drives itself through busy streets, highways, and unfamiliar roads. This is no longer just a science-fiction concept. Self-driving cars are becoming an important part of modern technological development, combining artificial intelligence, machine learning, cameras, radar, sensors, and advanced computer systems to transform transportation.

This podcast explores the fascinating world of autonomous vehicles and examines how they are changing the way people travel. Across two episodes, we discover how self-driving technology works, how artificial intelligence makes driving decisions, and how major technology and automotive companies are developing vehicles that require less human involvement.

We also explore the potential benefits of autonomous transportation, including improved road safety, reduced traffic congestion, greater mobility for elderly and disabled individuals, and increased travel convenience.

However, this technological revolution also raises important questions about road safety, cybersecurity, legal responsibility, employment, and public trust.

Beyond the Steering Wheel takes listeners on a journey into the future of transportation, examining both the exciting possibilities and the challenges that must be overcome before driverless cars become a common part of everyday life.

Each episode, one real question goes to the table, and history's great teachers answer in their own voices and their own words: Jung, Lao Tzu, Feynman, Socrates, Marcus Aurelius and more — disagreeing, often. From Talking with the Masters (talkingwiththemasters.com). Teachers, not gods.

description:
Welcome to The Deen Between Us! We're Sulekha and Amira, two young Muslim women sharing our experiences as we grow in faith.
This podcast is a space for honest conversations about deen, friendships, relationships, personal growth, and everything in between.
We're not scholars, and we don't have all the answers. We're learning, making mistakes, and striving to become better Muslims.

description: In a world where magic is taught in public school, you can flunk spellcraft in the morning and catch a stray hex from the lunch tables by noon. For a quiet new kid ignorant of his power, a little talent is enough to get invited into a whole lot of trouble.

From people-pleasing and self-doubt to confidence, starting again and learning to trust yourself, this is a space to pause, reflect and feel a little less alone.
I'm so glad you're here. 🤍
Email: dearfliss@gmail.com

Ever had a random thought and wondered, “Am I the only person who thinks about this?” Welcome to Let Me Askew, where I Antonio Askew gets into bizarre life questions, wild takes, and insane experiences. From everyday things nobody questions to stories you couldn’t make up, there’s always something worth talking about.

Two moms. Two mics. Zero filter.
Welcome to Spill & Crime — where true crime meets real life. We’re talking cases we can’t stop thinking about, the latest stories everyone’s talking about, motherhood, relationships, everyday chaos, and everything in between.
Some episodes get dark. Some get personal. Some completely derail. But nothing is off limits.
Come for the crime. Stay for the spill. ☕️🔪

title: Honestly, Dear Listener
author: Honestly, Dear Listener
description:
Being a creative person is tough. 
We want to make cool things, but then life hits us with insecurity, rejection, schedules, etc. How do we push past all the noise and make the things that light us up? 

Welcome, Dear Listener, to a space where it's okay to ask questions and dive deep into the world of fear, creativity, and the roadblocks that get in the way of us busting forth with creativity energy. We're a couple of weirdos who want to talk about the hard things with you, so welcome to our living room--pull up a chair, cover up with a cozy blanket, and let's get started.

title: Healing the Sacred
author: American Indian Law Alliance
description:
Onondaga Lake lies in Central New York State. It is the sacred site where Gayanashagowa, the Great Law of Peace, was established. The lake is also known for severe pollution, the result of industrial use that desecrated it.

The Onondaga Nation is one of the six nations of the Haudenosaunee Confederacy. As Keepers of the Central Fire, the Onondaga Nation carries the responsibility of maintaining unity and peace within the Confederacy. The Onondaga Nation has brought a petition to the Organization of American States seeking land rights to the lake.

Fire up the podcast, let your spirit unwind, and have a good, hearty laugh—life’s exhausting enough as it is, so why not choose to be happy? 🤣🎤

description:
The hate doesn't hide anymore. No Hoods Needed is a podcast about racism in America today — the hate crimes, ICE raids, rigged labs, and official cruelty done in the open, told from the record.
Hosted by Mr. Black History, each episode takes one story through four questions: What did they call it? What does the record show? Who paid? And where does it stand? Documents, charges, and court findings — read out loud, victims first, no cushioning.
New episodes Saturdays. Season One starts November 28, 2026.

We've spent a lot of our lives listening to the peanut gallery. And some of those voices have been in our heads for so long, we've mistaken them for our own.
What if we started listening to ourselves?
Done Asking with Nat Callender explores who we believe we're supposed to be in relating with others and ourselves. 
Expect curiosity, humor and audacity with an invitation to unlearn some stuff and discover how much more expansive life can be.
This isn't about becoming a better version of you or fixing something that's broken. It's about the freedom you feel when you become more of yourself.

title: Sugar & Grit: Small Business Stories from the Founders of eCreamery Ice Cream
author: Abby Jordan & Becky App
description:
Sugar & Grit is a small business podcast from Abby Jordan and Becky App, the business partners and women entrepreneurs behind eCreamery Ice Cream Gifts. Every episode goes behind the scenes of starting and growing a food, CPG, or direct-to-consumer ecommerce brand, one obstacle at a time. By our count, we’ve survived about 337,000 of them.

Fair warning: this is not a podcast full of tidy success stories. We built eCreamery, an online food business that ships ice cream nationwide, which takes a lot more than a good recipe. It’s also seasonal, which is a beautiful way of saying we had no idea when we’d get paid. We went on Shark Tank and walked out with zero deals and one great story. We took on investors, then bought our company back. Finally.

Every episode, we pick one obstacle and tell you everything: what broke, the creative fix that got us through, and what we’d do differently with a do-over. How do you survive the slow season? How do you get press when nobody knows your name? How do you stop shouting into the void and get your marketing heard? And how do two polar opposite business partners stay on the same side for nearly 20 years?

Hanging off a cliff of your own right now? Send us your obstacle at sugarandgrit.com/pages/obstacles. We read every one, and yours could become an episode.

Pull up a chair (and grab a spoon) if you’re dreaming of your own startup or already in the thick of it: food and CPG founders, specialty food and gift makers, family businesses, women-led companies, and anyone who’d rather be the boss than report to one.

New episodes every Tuesday at sugarandgrit.com.

Hosted by author and narrative strategist Cat Margulis, Existential is an intimate podcast exploring what it means to be human through the stories we live and the meaning we make of them.

Welcome to The Nikki Evans Show…

where we see the truth, do the work, and become the proof.


This isn’t a polished podcast.

It’s a place to come home. Where laughter, movement is the jam, faith and storytelling happen. 

I’m Nikki—wife, woman of faith, and someone who knows what it feels like to give everything… and still lose yourself somewhere along the way.

There was a version of me who kept the peace, carried the weight, and called it love.

A version of me who was always “fine”… but never fully alive.

And then everything in me started asking for more.

Not more from my husband.

Not more from my life.

More truth.

More alignment.

More of the woman God actually created me to be.

Out here, on 17 acres of dirt roads, horses, and quiet moments with God… I started finding her again.

This podcast is for the woman who feels unseen in her marriage, disconnected in her body, and tired of pretending she’s okay.

We’re not fixing men here.

We’re not performing healing.

We’re coming back to life.

For real this time.

So whether you’re folding laundry, driving backroads, or sitting in the silence wondering “is this it?”…

You’re not alone anymore.

title: Prince Eugene of Savoy (Military Leader in Europe)
author: George Bruce Malleson
description:
Prince Eugene of Savoy, a master tactician and diplomat, reshaped the battlefield of early 18th-century Europe. As the son of a minor noble, Eugene defied expectations, rising to prominence in the imperial army during a time of intense conflict. This audiobook unveils his extraordinary journey, revealing how he navigated the treacherous waters of war, politics, and personal ambition.

Listeners will delve into the central conflict of Eugene's life as he faces powerful enemies and political intrigue, all while championing the Habsburg dynasty against the formidable forces of France and the Ottoman Empire. Malleson paints a vivid portrait of Eugene's strategic brilliance, showcasing his pivotal victories at the Battle of Zenta and the Siege of Belgrade, which not only altered the course of history but also solidified his legacy as one of the greatest military leaders of his time.

But this audiobook isn’t just about battles; it explores the man behind the uniform—his complex relationships, the sacrifices he made, and the personal demons he battled. What drove Eugene to greatness, and what did he lose along the way? Each chapter peels back the layers of his character, inviting listeners to ponder the true cost of ambition and glory.

Join us on this captivating journey through a life marked by valor, cunning, and relentless pursuit of honor. Whether you’re a history buff or a casual listener, this exploration of Prince Eugene’s life promises to enlighten and inspire.

Rendezvous with Alysia - Long before podcasts became the platform of choice for celebrities, creators, and cultural voices, Alysia Stern was already building a platform for conversation.

In 2012, Rendezvous with Alysia became one of the first podcasts to launch on Madhouse TV, stepping into the emerging world of digital broadcasting before podcasting became the phenomenon it is today.

From entertainers, actors, musicians, authors, entrepreneurs, and rising talent to extraordinary people with stories worth telling, Alysia has always believed that everyone has a story — and the right conversation can make the world stop and listen.


With a natural curiosity, an eye for talent, and a passion for discovering the person behind the public persona, Alysia brings a different energy to every rendezvous. It's not just about fame. It's about the journey, the ambition, the breakthroughs, the setbacks, and the stories that make people who they are.

Now, with the entertainment world more connected than ever, Rendezvous with Alysia is opening the door to a new generation of talent, established names, and voices ready for their moment.


From Hollywood to the independent scene, from household names to the next big discovery, the invitation remains the same:

Come sit down. Tell your story. Let's make it a rendezvous.

sick lit girl is a podcast about how to keep living and creating when trapped in the physical hellscape of chronic pain and chronic illness. There are also episodes on culture, the arts, literature, writing, psychology, the erotic, and more. SLG spent nearly a decade as a psychoanalytic therapist, largely offline, and lived quite fully - engaging in creative projects and working full-time. That all came crashing down following near death experiences in 2022 and the onset of severe chronic pain and disabling health issues. She lost everything. This is a project about survival and what's left of a creative life when your body regularly reminds you of your mortality.


Episodes can be solo and also sometimes feature guests too. Expect conversations on the nature of creativity, struggle, mental/physical health challenges, literature, film, art, sex work, psychoanalysis, and more. Each story reveals the intricate customs surrounding birth, death, marriage, and naming, offering listeners a rare glimpse into the values and beliefs that shape the Winnebago identity.

As you listen, you'll uncover the significance of various clans and their unique contributions to the tribe's rich history. The tension between tradition and modernity weaves through these narratives, prompting listeners to reflect on their own connections to heritage and community. With every tale, LaMere not only preserves the legacy of the Winnebago people but also ignites curiosity about the timeless lessons embedded in their lore.

Whether you're seeking to deepen your understanding of Native American culture or simply enjoy stories that resonate with universal themes of resilience and belonging, 'Winnebago Stories' offers an enlightening journey. Off the Cuff is about the real people and stories behind crime, prison and the justice system.

I sit down with former prisoners, prison officers, victims, families, campaigners and others whose lives have been shaped by the system to have honest conversations about what happened, what prison is really like, what needs to change and what happens when people are given a second chance.

These aren't conversations about excusing crime or pretending that actions don't have consequences. They're about understanding the people, circumstances and experiences behind the headlines.

You didn’t start a business just to buy yourself a stressful, 60-hour-a-week job. If your company demands every waking minute of your time while leaving you with thin margins and zero freedom, something is broken.


Welcome to The Relaxed Business Owner with Michael Clark, presented by Michael Clark Business Advisory. 


Hosted by straight-talking business strategist Michael Clark, this podcast is built around one simple rule: your business exists to serve your life, not consume it. 


In each episode, Michael sits down with proven operators, specialists, and coaches to strip away the fluff and hand you practical, commercial strategies you can implement right away. 


Tune in to learn how to:

  • Reclaim Your Time: Build repeatable systems, delegate low-value tasks, and structure your calendar so your business runs smoothly—even when you take a holiday.
  • Scale Without Wasting Money: Master data-driven advertising (Google and Meta Ads) alongside zero-dollar organic growth strategies that turn happy clients into five-star referrals.
  • Keep Your Best People: Prevent team burnout, stay ahead of workplace psychosocial safety obligations, and build a culture where top performers want to stay.
  • Win Higher-Value Clients: Ditch desperate networking and scarcity mindsets by niching down, collaborating with strategic B2B partners, and crafting irresistible offers.
  • Lead Like a True CEO: Overcome imposter syndrome, stop treating profit like a dirty word, and make clear, data-backed decisions that protect both your bank account and your personal life.


Whether you’re a solo operator looking to break through your first revenue ceiling or an established director ready to step back from the frontline,

The Relaxed Business Owner with Michael Clark gives you the playbook to earn more, work less, and actually enjoy the business you built. 


Hit follow now and start building a business that loves you back.

For more than a decade I’ve worked at the intersection of the handmade and the digital — pulling prints on an etching press one day, building accessible, human-centered websites and marketing strategy the next. This show is where those worlds come together, and where I share what I’ve learned with people who make things for a living and colleagues who champion authentic, universal design for marketing in the print and digital realms.
AI is not the end of craft. It's the newest tool on a very old bench. The makers who thrive will be the ones who keep their core skills sharp, their point of view clear, and the compassionate human touch at the center of the work.
Each episode, we dig into the real experience of making meaningful creative work today. Expect honest conversations about human-centered and accessible design, practical marketing roadmaps you can actually use, and approachable artistic techniques — from brand strategy to SEO / AEO, to woodcut prints and watercolor. We'll dip into strategy, pure craft, and the art of growing creatively and technically without losing the joy that made you want to create in the first place.
Because that’s really what this is: a community for the human-centered maker. Whether you’re an entrepreneur, an educator, a marketer, a designer, a fine artist, or some wonderful combination in between, you’ll find something here to sharpen your skills, spark your imagination, and remind you that you’re not navigating this shift alone.

title: Bridettes: Kicking Free From Child & Forced Marriage
author: Dr. Tamara MC
description:
Bridettes is the first and only podcast dedicated to child and forced marriage survivor stories from across religions, cultures, and communities. Hosted by Dr. Tamara MC, a child marriage survivor who was married at twelve in a cult in Texas.

Dr. MC speaks with survivors, therapists, legal experts, legislators, and advocates about child and forced marriage, coercive control, trafficking, and the lives survivors build on their own terms.

Long-form conversations make room for childhood memories, family relationships, the circumstances of marriage, the struggle to leave, and the complicated years that follow. We also make room for laughter, love, ambition, and joy.

Child marriage was legal in all fifty U.S. states until Delaware became the first to ban it without exceptions in 2018. Child marriage remains legal in the majority of states. Approximately 315,000 minors were married in the United States between 2000 and 2021, 86% of them girls. Worldwide, an estimated 640 million women and girls were married before eighteen, and 12 million more girls marry each year.

Our position is clear: end child marriage. Eighteen, no exceptions. Not for parents, judges, religion, or culture.

The name Bridettes reclaims “little brides.” We borrow the glamour, glitter, sequins, and sky-high kicks of the Radio City Rockettes and turn the chorus line into a celebration of survivor power.

Arm in arm, we're a kickline of survivors breaking down walls, kicking open doors, and smashing through the silence. There's room for every body, every voice, every choice.

Kick free. Kick back. Kick together.

Our conversations explore child marriage, forced marriage, sexual abuse, domestic and intimate partner violence, coercive control, human and familial trafficking, polygamy, female genital mutilation (FGM), domestic servitude, cults, spiritual and religious trauma, and the consequences of abuse, including complex PTSD.

We also examine isolation through homeschooling, the misuse of religious authority, and the legal barriers that can keep married children from accessing protection or leaving abusive relationships.

Guests include survivors from Christian, Muslim, Jewish, Hindu, Mormon, and secular backgrounds, alongside therapists, legal experts, lawmakers, and advocates working to end child marriage.

The show engages with the work of organizations including Unchained At Last, the National Coalition to End Child Marriage, Equality Now, and the AHA Foundation. We explore the laws that permit minors to marry, the exceptions that remain, and the efforts to close them.

You don't have to be a child marriage survivor to belong here. If you've experienced control through fear, money, family, or religion, or struggled to name what happened to you, there's room for you in the line.

Dr. Tamara MC is a child marriage survivor, social scientist, journalist, and activist whose work has appeared in more than 100 publications. She serves on the steering committee of the National Coalition to End Child Marriage and has contributed to legislative efforts to ban child marriage across the United States. She is writing her memoir, CHILD BRIDE.

Bridettes aims to create the world's largest oral-history archive of child and forced marriage survivor testimony, preserving our experiences and making them accessible to survivors, researchers, educators, advocates, and policymakers.

Through firsthand accounts, we expose the systems that enable abuse, challenge the silence, and strengthen efforts to protect children.

Find updates at www.tamaramc.com.

Welcome to the line. Sparkle on. Sparkle strong. 💖

~Tamara MC, Ph.D.

My 60 year old Dad and I react to the wildest stories we can find across the internet! From Reddit and Quora to Mumsnet and beyond.
Expect outrageous relationships, dating disasters, family drama, unbelievable arguments, AITA dilemmas and some stories that genuinely make us question what we’ve just read. Two generations, very different opinions, and absolutely no idea what we’re going to find next.
